description: Custom Search Console report when site_overview is not specific enough: group by query, page, country, device or date (up to two at once), filter by query or page text, sort, and optionally add the change against the previous period. Returns a table with clicks, impressions, CTR and position per row. Read-only.

compare_previous.description: Add each row's change against the previous period of the same length. Default false.

days.description: Length of the period in days, 7 to 480, ending about 3 days ago because Google data lags. It is compared with the same number of days right before it. Default 28.

filter_page.description: Keep only pages whose URL contains this text, e.g. "/blog/".

filter_query.description: Keep only search queries that contain this text (case-insensitive), e.g. a brand or product name.

group_by.description: One or two dimensions to break the numbers down by, e.g. ["query"] or ["page", "query"]. Default ["query"].

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, 1 to 200. Default 25.

site.description: The Search Console property to read. Accepts "example.com", "https://example.com/" or "sc-domain:example.com". Call list_sites first if unsure which properties exist.

sort_by.description: Which number to sort rows by, highest first (position: best first). Default clicks.

name: search_performance
title: Search performance (custom)
